title: ACP 2.0 research Proposal (minimal reference v1)
description: Minimal reference Proposal contract frozen by T-03 / C01b. A Proposal is a scientific hypothesis plus a reproducible plan definition and its approval binding. It is NOT a task/job state machine: it carries no job_id, attempt, lifecycle, queue or running state, and status-like task fields are rejected by the schema's `not` clause. The only state it names is the research decision (proposed/approved/rejected/superseded/deferred) and, as display metadata only, the approval projection. plan_definition_digest is the canonical projection of the scientific definition (recipe_digest, science, budget, allowed_change_scope) and deliberately excludes approval_ref, approval status, timestamps, display names and later-appended TaskRef/evidence references. The full P2 resource envelope is versioned later; this document freezes names, not the P2 field superset.
$comment: Executable vocabulary is JSON Schema 2020-12 only. range/nullable exist solely inside ui_dialect as non-executable UI annotations with a written standard equivalent. TaskRef/evidence refs are intentionally absent: a Proposal precedes execution, so appending them must never change plan_definition_digest.

range.scope: UI annotation only; a generic 2020-12 validator must not execute it

nullable.scope: UI annotation only; a generic 2020-12 validator must not execute it

ui_dialect.rule: Only supported_keywords are executable. range/nullable must never appear outside this ui_dialect block.

proposal_id.description: Stable proposal identity. Project-scoped; never reused for a different plan definition.

project_id.description: Project scope resolved server-side. A client must not assert a different project in a task/evidence reference.

question_ref.description: Reference to the frozen QuestionSpec this proposal answers.

question_revision.description: QuestionSpec revision the hypothesis was formed against.

reaction_ref.description: Reference to the frozen reaction/species definition supplied by A; C never infers endo/exo from a name.

hypothesis.description: Falsifiable hypothesis. A model narrative is not a substitute for the scientific plan below.

recipe_digest.description: Digest of the A-owned Recipe/capability definition. C references it; C does not copy the science schema.

plan_definition_digest.description: Canonical digest over ONLY recipe_digest + science + budget + allowed_change_scope. See plan-identity.md. Excludes approval_ref, approval_status, updated_at, display_name, decision, human_edits and all later TaskRef/evidence refs.

approval_ref.description: Reference to the runtime Approval bound to plan_definition_digest + project_id + budget + allowed_change_scope. Null before approval is requested. The reference itself is excluded from plan_definition_digest.

round.description: Research round index. A research iteration counter, not a task attempt or a job lifecycle state.

decision.description: Research decision about the hypothesis. It is not a task/job status enum.

created_at.description: Creation timestamp. Never part of plan_definition_digest.

human_edits.description: Auditable human edits. Never part of plan_definition_digest.

approval_status.description: Display projection of the Approval. Never part of plan_definition_digest and never authority to dispatch.

updated_at.description: Display/volatile update timestamp. Never part of plan_definition_digest.

display_name.description: Human-facing label only. Never part of plan_definition_digest.

not.description: A Proposal must not carry task/job state-machine fields. Task state lives only in the platform task record; the Workbench must not derive or store a second one.

digest.description: Lowercase sha256 with the sha256: prefix. Never a mutable value.

capability_id.description: A-owned capability identifier from the Recipe. Not an MCP tool name.

parameters.description: Resolved capability parameters. Quantity values are {value, unit}; see plan-identity.md.

sha256.description: Actual input bytes digest. Changing the bytes changes plan_definition_digest.

method.description: QC method/level identity, e.g. r2SCAN-3c. A normalization or fallback silently changing it is forbidden.

mapping.description: Atom/geometry mapping identity (A-owned). C must not infer it from a molecule name.

charge.description: Total charge. Explicitly part of the scientific identity; never defaulted by a model.

spin_multiplicity.description: Spin multiplicity. Explicitly part of the scientific identity; never defaulted by a model.

temperature.description: Optional temperature quantity. Only base unit kelvin is accepted in the digest projection.

unit.description: Explicit budget unit. The reference contract counts new local TaskRefs.

count.description: Maximum new tasks for this proposal/round. Changing it changes plan_definition_digest.

timeout_s.description: Hard wall-clock cap. Changing it changes plan_definition_digest.

wall_clock_s.description: Optional aggregate wall-clock cap in seconds.

mode.description: none = no substitution after approval. finite_list = only the enumerated finite substitutions are allowed; any other change requires a new proposal and approval.

field_path.description: Stable machine field path inside science.

editor_ref.description: Opaque principal reference; never a credential value.
